company: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research
description: Worked as a Project Assistant under Prof. Shobhana Narasimhan, using VASP for first-principles simulations of nanoscale materials. In collaboration with researchers at IISER Thiruvananthapuram, studied Ge/SiGe semiconductor heterointerfaces to investigate the emergence of lower-dimensional electron and hole gases. The work examined how atomic-scale variations produce interfacial states relevant to quantum information technologies.
Completed practical work in robotics and embedded systems through Ixar Robotics and Teachnook's IIT Roorkee partnership, with a focus on prototype development and system integration.

company: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research
description: Completed the Science Research Fellowship Programme at JNCASR, using VASP to reproduce and analyse published first-principles results for the structural and electronic properties of CsPbBr₃. The work developed practical experience with SCF convergence, band-structure calculations, density of states, and charge-density analysis, alongside additional exploration of CsPbCl₃ and WSe₂ systems.
